claims.claim: Egypt signed a $1 billion World Bank financing agreement, signed by Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty on Sunday.
claims.episode_span: signed a $1 billion World Bank financing agreement on Sunday
claims.source_title: Egypt signs $1 billion World Bank deal as war compounds economic pressures
claims.supporting_quote: The deal, signed by Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty on Sunday, is the second of three concessional development policy operations.

claims.claim: The World Bank operation includes a $200 million British credit guarantee and is tied to reforms of state-owned enterprises, competition, tax collection and borrowing costs.
claims.episode_span: includes a $200 million British credit guarantee and is tied to reforms
claims.source_title: Egypt signs $1 billion World Bank deal as war compounds economic pressures
claims.supporting_quote: Approved by the bank's board in May, it includes a $200 million British credit guarantee and is tied to reforms of state-owned enterprises, competition rules, tax collection and the cost of government borrowing.

claims.claim: Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly said oil was trading around $110 a barrel against $75 assumed in the budget, and the government chose to absorb the costs at this stage.
claims.episode_span: oil was trading around $110 a barrel, against $75 assumed in the budget
claims.source_title: Egypt signs $1 billion World Bank deal as war compounds economic pressures
claims.supporting_quote: Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly told the Egypt Forum in late October that oil was trading around $110 a barrel, against $75 assumed in the budget.

claims.claim: Finance Minister Ahmed Kouchouk put subsidies at 840 billion Egyptian pounds this fiscal year, with borrowing costs bringing the real bill near 1 trillion pounds.
claims.episode_span: subsidies at 840 billion Egyptian pounds ($15 billion) this fiscal year
claims.source_title: Egypt signs $1 billion World Bank deal as war compounds economic pressures
claims.supporting_quote: Finance Minister Ahmed Kouchouk put subsidies at 840 billion Egyptian pounds ($15 billion) this fiscal year, with borrowing costs adding about 20 per cent to bring the real bill near EGP 1 trillion ($17.9 billion).

claims.claim: The dollar rose almost 8 percent against the Egyptian pound, from about 52 to above 56 on October 26, and about $4 billion of foreign money left Egyptian government debt between October 15 and 26.
claims.episode_span: The dollar rose by almost 8 percent, from about 52 pounds
claims.source_title: Egypt signs $1 billion World Bank deal as war compounds economic pressures
claims.supporting_quote: The dollar rose by almost 8 per cent, from about EGP 52 at the start of October to break a record above EGP 56 on October 26.

claims.claim: Egypt's central bank raised rates by 100 basis points to 20 percent on Thursday and pushed its inflation target to late 2027.
claims.episode_span: raised rates by 100 basis points to 20 percent
claims.source_title: Egypt signs $1 billion World Bank deal as war compounds economic pressures
claims.supporting_quote: On Thursday, the bank raised rates by 100 basis points to 20 per cent, citing “challenging external conditions”.

claims.claim: Remittances to Egypt hit a record $33.9 billion in the first eight months of the year, and Suez Canal income has recovered to about $4.4 billion from near $10 billion before Red Sea attacks.
claims.episode_span: remittances hit a record $33.9 billion in the first eight months
claims.source_title: Egypt signs $1 billion World Bank deal as war compounds economic pressures
claims.supporting_quote: Remittances hit a record $33.9 billion in the first eight months of the year, but tourism revenue grew 1.7 per cent over the same period, compared with 16.3 per cent growth in the fiscal year ending June 2025.

claims.claim: Ukraine's Air Force said its Air Alert app sent fake nuclear, chemical and street-fighting warnings late Sunday and that there was no radiation threat.
claims.episode_span: fake warnings of a radiation threat, a chemical attack and street fighting
claims.source_title: Nuclear radiation in Russia, Ukraine? No, just hacked warning alerts
claims.supporting_quote: Ukraine’s Air Force said late on Sunday that users of its Air Alert app, which warns people of incoming air attacks, received fake warnings of nuclear and chemical threats to areas in and around Kyiv.

claims.claim: Ukraine's Center for Strategic Communications blamed Russia for the fake alerts, citing a Russian-language message.
claims.episode_span: Center for Strategic Communications blamed Russia and pointed to the Russian-language message
claims.source_title: Nuclear radiation in Russia, Ukraine? No, just hacked warning alerts
claims.supporting_quote: Ukraine’s Center for Strategic Communications blamed Russia. In a post on X, the agency pointed to the use of the Russian language in one of the fake messages.

claims.claim: Al Jazeera said this appears to be the first time either Ukraine's or Russia's official alert apps have been hacked, and the fake threats began as a six-day Kherson ceasefire ended.
claims.episode_span: the first time either country’s official alert app has been hacked
claims.source_title: Nuclear radiation in Russia, Ukraine? No, just hacked warning alerts
claims.supporting_quote: This appears to be the first time either Ukraine’s or Russia’s official alert apps have been hacked.

claims.claim: Sudan lodged complaints against Ethiopia with the UN Security Council and the African Union Peace and Security Council over drone attacks.
claims.episode_span: lodged complaints with the United Nations Security Council and the African Union’s Peace and Security Council
claims.source_title: Sudan files complaints against Ethiopia with UN over deadly drone spree
claims.supporting_quote: Sudan has lodged a complaint against Ethiopia with both the United Nations Security Council and the African Union’s Peace and Security Council after a series of deadly drone attacks this year.

claims.claim: Sudan's Transitional Sovereignty Council alleged 70 assaults with 187 one-way drones from February 15 to October 27 killed or wounded 484 civilians and killed 176 soldiers.
claims.episode_span: killed or wounded 484 civilians, killed 176 soldiers and wounded another 200
claims.source_title: Sudan files complaints against Ethiopia with UN over deadly drone spree
claims.supporting_quote: The attacks killed or wounded 484 civilians and killed 176 Sudanese soldiers, the report said, with another 200 soldiers wounded.

claims.claim: A UN spokesman said Secretary-General Antonio Guterres strongly condemns escalating drone attacks in Sudan by the parties to the conflict.
claims.episode_span: strongly condemns the escalating drone attacks in Sudan by the parties to the conflict
claims.source_title: Sudan files complaints against Ethiopia with UN over deadly drone spree
claims.supporting_quote: The secretary-general “strongly condemns the escalating drone attacks in Sudan by the parties to the conflict and the catastrophic toll these attacks are inflicting on civilians”, the spokesman said, adding that the strikes constitute violations of international humanitarian law.

claims.claim: The US Justice Department plans to send election monitors to Philadelphia and Allegheny, Luzerne and Lehigh counties on Election Day.
claims.episode_span: send election monitors to polling places in Philadelphia and in Allegheny, Luzerne and Lehigh counties
claims.source_title: The DOJ plans to send poll monitors to Philly on Election Day
claims.supporting_quote: The Department of Justice said it will send the observers to Philadelphia, as well as Allegheny, Luzerne, and Lehigh Counties, according to an Oct. 22 letter to the Pa. Department of State shared with The Inquirer.

claims.claim: DOJ trial attorney James T. Catania said monitors only observe and take notes, will not carry firearms, and will not wear DOJ insignia.
claims.episode_span: monitors “only observe and take notes,” will not intrude
claims.source_title: The DOJ plans to send poll monitors to Philly on Election Day
claims.supporting_quote: “Our monitors only observe and take notes. They do not intrude or interfere in any way in the voting process.”

claims.claim: The Justice Department plans to dispatch 1,000 poll monitors, up from 289 in 2022 and 714 in 2024, according to the Inquirer citing CBS News.
claims.episode_span: a record 1,000 monitors nationwide, up from 289 in the 2022 midterms
claims.source_title: The DOJ plans to send poll monitors to Philly on Election Day
claims.supporting_quote: The Justice Department plans to dispatch a record 1,000 poll monitors across the country, up from 289 during the 2022 midterms and 714 during the 2024 presidential election, per CBS News .

claims.claim: Pennsylvania officials said monitors must stay at least 10 feet from voting-machine areas and may not inspect equipment or demand records.
claims.episode_span: must stay at least 10 feet outside the area where voting machines are located
claims.source_title: The DOJ plans to send poll monitors to Philly on Election Day
claims.supporting_quote: In Pennsylvania, the monitors will be allowed inside polling locations, but must remain at least 10 feet outside the room or area where voting machines are located, a Department of State spokesperson said.
